472: def _controller_startup_scope(choice, caller_root, *, usage, root_kind):
473:     """Retain accepted controller input before the still-closed worker seam.
474: 
475:     No acquisition, worker start or model constructor is called here. Once a
476:     native permit is reserved, an unfinished scope remains quarantined under
477:     the existing exception-aware lifecycle; it never invents no-worker cleanup.
478:     """
479:     configured = _startup_configuration()
480:     authority, trusted, selected, store, snapshot = _STARTUP_RELEASE(choice, caller_root, root_kind=root_kind)
481:     _require(authority is configured, "Startup release changed during selection")
482:     profile = _STARTUP_PROFILE(authority, usage)
483:     manager, factory = SNAPSHOT_LIFECYCLE, RUNTIME_FACTORY
484:     _require(type(manager) is DurableSnapshotLifecycle and type(factory) is DurableOwnedRuntimeFactory
485:              and factory.manager is manager, "Exact durable startup lifecycle and factory required")
486:     custody = _StartupCustody(authority, trusted, selected, profile, usage, manager, factory)
487:     # Custody starts before any lease/admission/binding operation can fail.
488:     _CONTROLLER_STARTUP_ATTEMPTS[id(custody)] = custody
489:     try:
490:         # Retain the lease wrapper before entry can reserve protection.
491:         custody.lease = manager.read_lease(str(store), choice, selected.revision)
492:         _require(type(custody.lease) is _DurableLease and custody.lease.manager is manager,
493:                  "Exact issued durable lease required")
494:         _startup_selection_current(custody)
495:         with custody.lease:
496:             _startup_selection_current(custody)
497:             custody.admission = _STARTUP_ADMIT(trusted, choice, store, snapshot)
498:             admitted = custody.admission
499:             _require(type(admitted) is resolver.Admission and type(admitted.manifest) is resolver.TrustedManifest
500:                      and admitted.manifest == trusted and admitted.manifest.approval is authority.manifest_approval
501:                      and admitted.choice == choice and admitted.snapshot == str(snapshot)
502:                      and admitted.private_root == str(store), "Exact successful selected admission required")
503:             # Admission reparses the manifest; retain its exact selected object,
504:             # while retaining the initial approved manifest separately.
505:             custody.selected = next(model for model in admitted.manifest.models if model.choice == choice)
506:             _require(custody.selected == selected, "Admission selected a different model")
507:             _startup_selection_current(custody)
508:             custody.permit = custody.lease.begin_native_session()
509:             custody.record = custody.permit.record
510:             custody.key = custody.record.key
511:             custody.protection = custody.record.protection
512:             custody.token = custody.lease.token
513:             _startup_selection_current(custody)
514:             custody.binding = _STARTUP_BIND(admitted)
515:             b = custody.binding
516:             _require(type(b) is resolver.LocalBinding and b.choice == choice
517:                      and b.revision == custody.selected.revision
518:                      and b.manifest_sha256 == authority.manifest_approval.manifest_sha256
519:                      and b.model_path == admitted.snapshot and b.files == admitted.files
520:                      and b.local_files_only is True and b.constructor_called is False
521:                      and b.real_runtime_approved is False, "Exact rechecked local startup binding required")
522:             startup = _ControllerASRStart(authority, authority.manifest_approval, trusted,
523:                 admitted, custody.selected, profile, usage, b, custody.permit)
524:             custody.startup = startup
525:             custody.references, custody.values = _startup_references(custody), _startup_values(custody)
526:             _CONTROLLER_STARTUPS[id(startup)] = custody
527:             _validate_controller_startup(startup, custody.permit)
528:             try:
529:                 yield startup
530:             finally:
531:                 with manager._lock:
532:                     custody.active = False
533:     except BaseException as original:
534:         custody.primary_error = original
535:         raise
536:     finally:
537:         custody.active = False
538:         # A failed/reserved attempt remains retained. It is never converted to
539:         # completion by removing Python references or by a recorded digest.
540:         record = custody.lease.inner._record if type(custody.lease) is _DurableLease else None
541:         if record is not None and record.phase is Phase.RELEASED:
542:             _CONTROLLER_STARTUP_ATTEMPTS.pop(id(custody), None)
543:             if custody.startup is not None:
544:                 _CONTROLLER_STARTUPS.pop(id(custody.startup), None)

353:     def _flush_quarantine(self, key, original=None):
354:         token = self._token(key)
355:         try:
356:             with self._lock:
357:                 pending = self._kernel._pending_quarantine.pop(key, None)
358:             if pending is not None:
359:                 self._delegate.quarantine(key, *pending)
360:             persisted = self._reservations.quarantine(token, "operation_failed")
361:             with self._lock:
362:                 record = self._records.get(key)
363:                 if record is not None:
364:                     record.quarantine_persisted = persisted is True
365:                     record.quarantine_failure_type = None if persisted is True else "PendingTransition"
366:             if persisted is not True:
367:                 raise CleanupUnconfirmed("Quarantine append is pending or unconfirmed")
368:         except BaseException as error:
369:             if original is None:
370:                 raise
371:             original.add_note("Durable quarantine remains unconfirmed: " + type(error).__name__)

374: class _DurableLease:
375:     def __init__(self, manager, inner, binding):
376:         self.manager, self.inner, self.binding = manager, inner, binding
377:         self.token = None
378:         self._finalization_started = False
379: 
380:     def __enter__(self):
381:         manager = self.manager
382:         key = self.inner._key
383:         with manager._lock:
384:             if self.inner._entered or self.inner._exited:
385:                 raise SnapshotBusy("Lease object cannot be reused")
386:             old = manager._records.get(key)
387:             if key in manager._entering or old is not None and old.phase is not Phase.RELEASED:
388:                 raise SnapshotBusy("Semantic snapshot already entering, leased or quarantined")
389:             entry = object()
390:             manager._entering[key] = entry
391:         installed = False
392:         try:
393:             physical, semantic, generation, creation = self.binding
394:             # The semantic entry slot prevents token replacement while journal
395:             # I/O occurs outside the state lock. Physical exclusion is separate.
396:             self.token = manager._reservations.begin(physical, semantic, generation, creation)
397:             with manager._lock:
398:                 old = manager._records.get(key)
399:                 if (manager._entering.get(key) is not entry
400:                         or old is not None and old.phase is not Phase.RELEASED):
401:                     raise SnapshotBusy("Semantic entry changed before token publication")
402:                 manager._tokens[key] = self.token
403:                 installed = True
404:             self.inner.__enter__()
405:             return self
406:         except BaseException as original:
407:             if self.token is not None:
408:                 if installed:
409:                     manager._flush_quarantine(key, original)
410:                 else:
411:                     try:
412:                         manager._reservations.quarantine(self.token, "acquire_failed")
413:                     except BaseException as error:
414:                         original.add_note("Unpublished reservation quarantine unconfirmed: " + type(error).__name__)
415:             raise
416:         finally:
417:             with manager._lock:
418:                 if manager._entering.get(key) is entry:
419:                     del manager._entering[key]
420: 
421:     def begin_native_session(self):
422:         return self.inner.begin_native_session()
423: 
424:     def confirm_native_closed(self):
425:         return self.inner.confirm_native_closed()
426: 
427:     def __exit__(self, exc_type, exc_value, traceback):
428:         manager, key = self.manager, self.inner._key
429:         with manager._lock:
430:             if self._finalization_started:
431:                 return False
432:             self._finalization_started = True
433:         try:
434:             result = self.inner.__exit__(exc_type, exc_value, traceback)
435:         except BaseException as original:
436:             manager._flush_quarantine(key, original)
437:             raise
438:         with manager._lock:
439:             record = self.inner._record
440:             released = record is not None and record.phase is Phase.RELEASED
441:         if not released:
442:             manager._flush_quarantine(key, exc_value)
443:             return result
444:         try:
445:             # The fixed kernel retains its completed teardown observations;
446:             # this is not a journal/process-field-to-capability conversion.
447:             evidence = manager._delegate.completion_evidence(self.token.worker)
448:             manager._reservations.complete(self.token, evidence)
449:         except BaseException as original:
450:             with manager._lock:
451:                 record.phase = Phase.QUARANTINED
452:                 record.reason = "Final durable completion was not confirmed"
453:                 record.quarantine_persisted = False
454:                 record.quarantine_failure_type = type(original).__name__
455:             if isinstance(exc_value, BaseException):
456:                 exc_value.add_note("Final durable completion failed: " + type(original).__name__)
457:                 return False
458:             raise
459:         return result
